name: Wild Tiger

features.name: Adjustable lines
features.description: Play 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 lines on a 5x4 grid.

features.name: Tiger wild
features.description: Substitutes for all symbols except the scatter.

review:
An easy-going Asian 5x4 game where you pick your lines: 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100.

The tiger is wild for everything except the yin-yang scatter. Medium-low volatility is rare in BGaming's modern games, and paired with an excellent 97.16% RTP and a 3,000x cap, this is one of the gentlest games we list. Great for long demo sessions or careful players.
pros: Excellent 97.16% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
